text: {"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strncasecmp() decremented s1 instead of incrementing it, so the first string was walked backwards; changed `*s1--` to `*s1++`."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strcspn() walked the string backwards (--p) instead of forwards (++p), so it returned wrong lengths and failed the strspn KUnit test."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_get_size(), the loop reducing a >32-bit size decremented the exponent counter i instead of incrementing it, producing a negative index and the \"UNK\" unit; changed i-- to i++."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "string_escape_mem() walked the source buffer backwards (*src--) instead of forwards (*src++), so it read bytes before the input and produced wrong output and length."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "string_unescape() only entered the escape-processing path when the backslash was followed by NUL (src[1] == '\\0'), so no escape sequences were ever decoded; fixed the condition to src[1] != '\\0'."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "get_option() rewound the pointer (--cur) instead of skipping the leading '-' (++cur), so negative numbers after a comma failed to parse."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_options(), the loop-exit condition was inverted (`res != 1` instead of `res == 1`), so parsing stopped after the first range or comma-terminated integer; restored the break to trigger only when an integer without a trailing comma is found."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In memparse(), the 'G' suffix case used a no-op `ret << 10` instead of `ret <<= 10`, so gigabyte values (e.g. mem=1G) were parsed wrongly; restored the compound assignment."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "Fixed the leftover-byte mask in __siphash_aligned from `len & (sizeof(u64) - 2)` back to `len & (sizeof(u64) - 1)`, which had dropped the low bit and mishashed inputs with an odd number of trailing bytes."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "In 64-bit __hsiphash_aligned, the trailing-bytes mask was `len & (sizeof(u64) - 2)` which drops bit 0 and miscomputes `left` for odd lengths; restored it to `sizeof(u64) - 1`."}
